name: 02-startup-self-check
description: The first init() with a tracer provider emits one flywheel.startup span. A later init() emits none. Each selfCheck() emits one. With a tracer and a logger provider, the check is ok.
covers: setup: init() returns the live instance, and runs the self-check
practice 4: the first init() with a tracer provider emits one flywheel.startup span, at the root of a new trace, on the flywheel tracer, with the version and schema counts
practice 4: a later init() emits no startup span, and selfCheck() emits one on each call
practice 4: with a tracer and a logger provider, selfCheck() reports ok with no issues, and the limit comes from the SDK
practice 4: init() writes nothing to the console when the check has no issue
practice 1 and 4: the turn names are registered when the package loads, so selfCheck() counts them before any turn
